\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows}

% Two setup registers determine the arrow's independent length and aperture.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{saved force}{saved force}{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.45pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.2\pgflinewidth
  \pgfutil@tempdimb=3\pgfutil@tempdima
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdimb by.35\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowssavethe\pgfutil@tempdima
  \pgfarrowssavethe\pgfutil@tempdimb
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-1.2\pgfutil@tempdima}
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{\pgfutil@tempdimb}
}{
  \pgfsetmiterjoin
  \pgfsetbuttcap
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{-1.2\pgfutil@tempdima}{-1.9\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{\pgfutil@tempdimb}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{-1.2\pgfutil@tempdima}{1.9\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqfillstroke
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[gray!35] (-3.2,0) -- (3.2,0);
  \draw[gray!35] (0,-2.35) -- (0,2.5);
  \fill (0,0) circle (2pt) node[below right] {$O$};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{saved force}] (0,0) -- (2.65,1.35) node[above right] {$\vec F$};
  \draw[red,line width=1pt,-{saved force}] (0,0) -- (-2.45,1.55) node[above left] {$\vec N$};
  \draw[green!50!black,line width=1.6pt,-{saved force}] (0,0) -- (0,-2.05) node[below] {$m\vec g$};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
